svg.title: Where each call goes: your phone sends camera frames, hold-to-talk audio and taps to the Fix-It Lens server over one WebSocket, and gets back sentences, outlines, verdicts and stops; it speaks in its own voice. Every model call goes through the server, and code there decides. Muse Wonder reads the manual and drafts the card. Muse Spark guides, boxes the part, judges a step and reads a plate. SAM 3.1 outlines the part and tracks it as a second witness. Muse Voice turns hold-to-talk into text. In local mode, after two failed API calls, Muse Glimmer takes the same roles on a GPU on your own network, with no SAM and no voice input.
svg.text: Five models. One server calls them all.
